cohort: 24 pregnant women with pSS who underwent ART, 70 women with pSS who had natural planned pregnancies, and 96 healthy women who underwent ART, from five tertiary hospitals from Guangdong Province from 2013 to 2022.
finding: ART is an effective method for infertility in patients with pSS, with a high live birth rate, but premature delivery is a leading maternal adverse outcome, and birthweight is lower in offspring from pSS mothers with ART.
birth_weight: 2434.4 +/- 722.1 g (pSS with ART), 2844.9 g (natural pregnancy in pSS), 3072.1 g (healthy mothers with ART)
